name: QTT Product Access
description: The join the whole product-agnostic model hinges on: Membership x Product x Role. Being a member of a tenant grants no product access by itself — a real, active row here is required. See the QTT SaaS Platform architecture document, section 7, and the hardening review, section 4.

fields.label: Tenant
fields.description: Denormalized from `membership` for direct indexed queries — kept in sync in validate(), never independently editable in practice.

fields.label: Product Role
fields.description: Must be one of the role_key values in the referenced Product's own role catalog (QTT Product.roles) — validated server-side in validate(), never a platform-hardcoded list. Options are populated dynamically per the selected Product by qtt_product_access.js (api/product.py::get_product_role_options), not stored statically here.
